title: Just found this sub. I can’t believe I’m not the only one…
content: Been having dreams about malls for years. I even made a post about it on r/deadmalls awhile back. The dreams are always the same though. The malls are old and going to shut down soon. Not many stores open and usually very few people. I always walk around looking for something but I’m not sure what. The majority of my dreams take place in recurring areas. A library, an aquarium, a gas station. Some places look almost exactly like my home town but they’re always slightly different. It’s almost like an alternate reality.
